42736.en: Let A', B', C' be the orthic axis intercepts of lines BC, CA, AB, resp. Let L_{A}, L_{B}, L_{C} be the reflections of the orthic axis in BC, CA, AB, resp. Let A_{B}, A_{C} be the orthogonal projections of A' on L_{B}, L_{C}, resp. Define B_{C}, B_{A}, C_{A}, C_{B} cyclically. The circumcircles of :g:`A'A_{B}A_{C} << A' A_B A_C >>`, :g:`B'B_{C}B_{A} << B' B_C B_A >>`, :g:`C'C_{A}C_{B} << C' C_A C_B >>` are coaxial, and X_42736 is the centroid of their centers. (See Hyacinthos #21468, Antreas Hatzipolakis, Jan 30, 2013) (Randy Hutson, May 31, 2021)
